title: Answer flips in training-free video token compression: code and data
description: Code, per-question outputs and analysis scripts for the paper 'Accuracy Parity Is Not Fidelity: Answer Flips in Training-Free Video Token Compression'. The study measures how often training-free token compression changes the answers of video large language models beyond the changes caused by harmless input variation (frame-sampling shifts and option reordering), on LLaVA-OneVision-7B, LLaVA-Video-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B over five video benchmarks, with V-CAST as a ninth method and six further harmless passes. Source repository: https://github.com/ShanaxWorld/flip-study
